prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students are familiar with the theoretical foundations of 3D-CAD systems and the possibilities associated with different modeling types.

They can apply basic knowledge of mechanics, kinematics, and strength of materials for the design and calculation of simple technical components. They can calculate and dimension selected machine elements in accordance with standards and select them functionally.

syllabus_topics: Working method with/of CAD systems, CAD data model
Possibilities of CAE and KBE in modern work processes
Training of content on a 3D-CAD system by creating a simple mechanical engineering assembly with drawing generation according to the possibilities in cooperation with an industrial company
Causes of failure, stress and strength, equivalent stress, fatigue strength, strength-reducing influences, load determination
Standard-compliant design and application of selected machine elements (e.g. axles/shafts, rolling bearings, shaft-hub connections) considering material, manufacturing, assembly, operation, and costs
